subject: 2023 Medford Bytes Year in Review
overview: Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan reflected on personal milestones, local community engagement, and podcast achievements from 2023. They also previewed upcoming events and goals for 2024.

items.title: Welcome and Local Restaurant Reflection
items.summary: The hosts reviewed El Tacuba in Medford, discussing its food, drinks, and atmosphere.

items.title: Host Updates and Personal Milestones
items.summary: Keshavan shared updates on pursuing a master's in public policy at Tufts University and participating in an equity committee at Harvard, while Balocca highlighted her work with the Charter Study Committee and community events.

items.title: Preview of Upcoming Discussion Series with Dr. Ravi Shankar
items.summary: Keshavan previewed an upcoming January discussion series centered on Dr. Ravi Shankar's memoir, Correctional.

items.title: 2023 Podcast Highlights and Metrics
items.summary: Balocca reviewed key milestones for Medford Bytes, including passing 100 episodes, covering the municipal elections, hosting podcasting classes at the library, and reviewing Spotify Wrapped listenership statistics.

items.title: End-of-Year Reflections and Goals for 2024
items.summary: The hosts shared reflections on personal growth and community involvement, encouraging listener feedback and guest suggestions for the upcoming year.
